name: Runaway Loop Watchdog Guard
description: Implement Watchdog in src/watchdog.ts that aborts execution when an iteration threshold is exceeded.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement Watchdog in src/watchdog.ts: constructor accepts maxTicks: number. Methods: tick(): void throws Error('Runaway execution detected') if tick count exceeds maxTicks; reset(): void resets tick counter. Ensure test/watchdog.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: Watchdog throws when tick count exceeds maxTicks
